title: OA-MAP: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Multimodal Framework for Interpretable Knee Osteoarthritis Progression
abstract: arXiv:2610.12134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) progression prediction can support patient monitoring, requiring the integration of multimodal data and multidomain expertise. Moreover, isolated risk estimates provide limited insight underlying a prediction. To automate the progression assessment workflow and reduce manual effort while providing interpretable findings and supporting evidence, we present OA-MAP, an autonomous multi-agent framework for evidence-grounded assessment of structural and pain progression in KOA. The system incorporates modality-specific agents including MRI, X-ray, and clinical agents, together with a coordinator agent. This framework can autonomously recruit specialist agents, select tools for prediction and analysis, and retrieve literature as external evidence based on user request and available patient information. translated_title: OA-MAP：面向可解释膝骨关节炎进展评估的证据驱动多智能体多模态框架
translated_abstract: 膝骨关节炎（KOA）进展预测可以支持患者监测，这需要整合多模态数据和跨领域专业知识。此外，孤立的风险估计对预测背后原因的洞察有限。为了自动化进展评估工作流程、减少人工工作，同时提供可解释的发现和支持证据，我们提出了OA-MAP，一个用于KOA结构和疼痛进展的证据驱动评估的自主多智能体框架。该系统包含针对特定模态的智能体，包括MRI、X射线和临床智能体，以及一个协调智能体。该框架能够根据用户请求和可用的患者信息，自主招募专科智能体、选择用于预测和分析的工具，并检索文献作为外部证据。一种基于不确定性的人机协同机制使临床医生能够审查和纠正中间发现。
tldr: 提出OA-MAP多智能体框架，整合MRI、X射线和临床数据，实现膝骨关节炎结构和疼痛进展的可解释、证据驱动的自动化预测，并通过人机协同机制允许临床医生审查和纠正中间结果。
en_tdlr: OA-MAP is an autonomous multi-agent framework integrating MRI, X-ray, and clinical data that delivers evidence-grounded, interpretable knee osteoarthritis progression prediction with a human-in-the-loop mechanism for clinician review.
